whatThisEstablishes: CONTRACT_DISCRIMINATION — whether the contract's own stated rule reaches the right verdict about a first-pass output. It is a local instrument with no provider call and therefore establishes NOTHING about how a model will behave. Per HAZLENZ_INVARIANTS, a contract change is never evidence that a behavioural defect is repaired.
whatThisDoesNotEstablish: that the remediated first pass will declare the owed property
that the remediated first pass will select the controlling property

BASELINE_210J.declarationTriggerSource: STATING AN UNRESOLVED FACT IN FULL: "The test is the one you have already applied ... If you would not have asked about it, do not declare it."
BASELINE_210J.refusesPropertyKindsSource: GATE 8 and GATE 12: state, not the process that would establish it

cases.observation: Fixed steel ladder to a syrup mezzanine, cage cut away from shoulder height up, no other fall protection. Rungs and stringers sound. Nobody has measured the rise.

owedProperties.proposition: what fall protection this ladder requires, which turns on the rise from the floor to the mezzanine deck

forbiddenSubstitutions.text: whether the rise has been measured
whether the mezzanine drawings are available

cases.observation: Spindle moulder with the Shaw guard and pressure pads removed, machinist hand feeding stock at the exposed cutter block without a push stick, intending to continue.

owedProperties.proposition: what guarding this cutter-block operation requires before the machine may run again

forbiddenSubstitutions.text: whether the machine handbook is available
whether the machinist has been trained

cases.family: exact underlying property vs control state
cases.observation: Plant room with a CO2 leak detection head bagged over since painting a fortnight ago. Two operatives entering and exiting during the shift. Nobody present has heard the ventilation fan start on its run-on timer.

owedProperties.proposition: whether the plant-room atmosphere is safe to enter

forbiddenSubstitutions.text: whether the ventilation fan is currently running
whether the detection head is uncovered
whether a portable CO2 reading has been taken

cases.family: exact underlying property vs evidence proxy
cases.observation: Theatre flying system wire ropes in daily use. The rigging book records a proof load test two years ago and nothing since. The ropes have not been examined.

owedProperties.proposition: whether the wire ropes are in a condition fit to carry the flown load

forbiddenSubstitutions.text: whether a current proof load test certificate exists
whether the annual proof load test has been carried out
whether the ropes have been examined

cases.family: exact property vs required act -- the act IS the property
cases.observation: A conveyor drive is due for belt replacement. The isolation point is a lockable disconnector on the wall. The permit is signed but nobody can say whether the lock was actually applied and the stored energy bled down before the guard came off.

owedProperties.proposition: whether the drive was locked off and the stored energy bled down before the guard was removed

cases.family: exact property vs required artifact -- the artifact IS the property
cases.observation: A mobile tower crane is rigged on site and due to lift tomorrow. No current thorough examination report is on site and the hire desk cannot say whether one exists.

owedProperties.proposition: whether a current thorough examination report for this crane exists, which is itself the statutory precondition for the lift

forbiddenSubstitutions.text: whether the crane appears to be in good condition

cases.observation: A hopper is hand cleared between batches. The access door interlock is fitted and tested working. Nobody can say how long the rotor takes to stop after the door opens, or how quickly an operator reaches into the hopper.

owedProperties.proposition: whether the rotor comes to rest before an operator can reach the hopper, that is whether run-down time is shorter than access time

forbiddenSubstitutions.text: whether the access door interlock is fitted and working
whether a means exists to verify the rotor has stopped
whether a mandatory waiting time is posted

cases.observation: A confined tank is to be entered. The last atmosphere reading was taken before the tank was washed out and nobody has taken one since. Separately, the agitator supply has been switched off at the panel but the isolation has not been locked or proved.

owedProperties.proposition: whether the tank atmosphere is safe to enter now, after the wash out

forbiddenSubstitutions.text: whether a fresh atmosphere reading has been taken

owedProperties.proposition: whether the agitator is isolated at zero energy and that isolation proved

forbiddenSubstitutions.text: whether the panel switch is in the off position

cases.family: genuinely safe / negated -- NO declaration is correct
cases.observation: A guarded bench grinder. The tool rest is set at two millimetres, the eye shield is in place and the wheel was dressed and inspected this morning with the record signed. The operator is wearing the issued face shield.
cases.restraintBasis: every control the hazard turns on is stated as present and current, and no answer to any remaining unknown would change what is done today.

cases.family: ordinary non-decision-critical unknown -- NO declaration is correct
cases.observation: A warehouse racking run is in good order and loaded within its plated capacity. The next scheduled rack inspection date is not recorded anywhere on site, though the last one was signed off six weeks ago.
cases.restraintBasis: the next inspection date bears on a later decision, not on whether the racking may be loaded today; the current condition and the plated capacity are both established, so no answer changes what is done now.
